200-day moving average line near $58. Weakening signals are occurring in the short-term momentum indicators.
Another glance at the chart above reveals what prices are doing, forming what I call an Arrow Chart Formation (orange box above). In effect, it is a triple-top formation, involving three consecutive penetration failures, which aligns with the price movements over the past few weeks.
See also: Is a Triple Top Pattern Forming on Stocks?
There are times when you want to "add to a known profit," and then there are times when you want to "fight the trend" and buy at new highs contrary to what I three months ago. This situation fits what I consider a trap; while sales might be high, there is no justification for buying this stock at present.
